title: A bend away from the camera barely shows
summary: A figure bending toward or away from the camera is foreshortened: the hinge reads as nothing. Turn the figure partly side-on (digger: ry 2.1 -> 1.85) so the bend is seen in profile.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

doc.when: Any action whose silhouette matters (bending, pointing, reaching).
doc.avoid: Staging the main action along the view axis.

problem.symptom: A strongly bent figure still reads upright on screen.
problem.cause: The bend is along the camera's view direction (foreshortened).
problem.fix: Rotate the figure toward profile (15-30 deg) until the bend reads.
